name.description: Full name of the person submitting the inquiry

company.description: Company or brand of the buyer

email.description: Work email of the buyer; primary identifier for follow-up

phone.description: Optional phone or WhatsApp number including country code

product.description: Short description of the product to source

category.description: Optional product category bucket (e.g. consumer electronics, apparel)

quantity.description: Estimated order quantity, free text (e.g. 1000 units / 20' FCL)

target_price.description: Optional target FOB or landed price, free text

message.description: Free-form brief, specs, certifications, packaging requirements

source_page.description: Page path where the inquiry was submitted (e.g. /, /services, /contact)

source_referrer.description: HTTP referrer at the time of submission

status.description: Internal sales pipeline status managed by the team
